༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga phun tshogs 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha bcu gsum gyi cho ga phun tshogs 'dod 'jo bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'od gsal nyid phyir kun tu 'gro ba'i mig 'phrul mkhan// gzhom med sgra brnyan thams cad skad phyir chos kyi ma mo chen mo ba// rnam med snang brnyan ro gcig nyid phyir lhan cig skyes dga'i wā ra hī// zla dang zla brnyan ji bzhin 'char phyir dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag mor 'dud// slob dpon chen po mai tri pas 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs su/ rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor gus// rnal 'byor ma nyid 'dren pa ru// byas nas 'khor lo rnam par bsgom// thams cad sngar bshad ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i nang gi rnal 'byor bshad par bya'o// de la gnas dang ldang ba nyid dang ni// 'jug dang yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// byin gyis brlab dang dbang bskur dang*// mchod dang ting 'dzin nye bar bsdu// zhes rnal 'byor gyi tshul dgu bshad pa'i dang po tshogs la gnas pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyin mor byed pa la baṃ/ de'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba'i lcags kyus 'chad bzhin pa'i mtshan nyid can bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang ldan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ thog mtha' 'dra/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shap+ta hūm̐/ bdag gis thog mtha' med pa'i dus mtha' nas// byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i// sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i// spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni// mi bgyid pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras pos bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// de dag la ni rjes su yi rang zhing*// byang chub tu ni yang dag bdag gis bsngo// rgyal ba la sogs dkon mchog gsum po la// dngos po kun kyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi// 'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas 'phrin las rnams// ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis bgyid par shog

/badz+ra muḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas bdag la thim par bsam mo// sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ de bzhin sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// de nas rang nyid rab tu mi gnas pa'i bdag nyid can gyi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la gnas par gyur/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba dharma shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa ldang ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin las langs te 'gro ba sgyu ma lta bur lta'o// de'i ngang la/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ suṃ ljang khu las ri rab kyi rtse mor paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma la oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ oṃ badz+ra pañdzā ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra dzā la trāṃ saṃ trāṃ/ rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi rol tu rdo rje me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūṃ las skyes pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs la sogs pa mtshan nyid tshang ba dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gi 'phreng ba mu khyud byas pa'i lte bar/ gsum pa 'jug pa ni/ nyi ma'i gdan la/

a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥtshar gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa hak+ṣaḥya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ gnyis g.yas/ ā li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma kha sbyar ba'i dbus su yi ge baṃ 'od zer lnga spro zhing sdud pa rdo rje phag mo rang gi ngo bo/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bzhi pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa'i khro mo spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra gsil bu phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar bas rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod par mdzad cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gru mo g.yon na he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams shing*/ gcer mo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can zhabs g.yon brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yas cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan te ye shes kyi me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ lnga pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ lha de dag gi spyi bor 'khor lor oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ snying gar rdo rje la hūm̐/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa/ pheṃ/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mig g.yon pa'i steng gi dpral ba'i thad kar bskor/ mig gyen du bzlog /rkang pa g.yas brkyang bas g.yon pa'i bol gong mnan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ de dag gis spros pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ chu de las byung ba'i rigs kyi bdag po gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung gnas/ mtshams ma bzhi la snang ba mtha' yas/ sgo ma bzhi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bdun pa mchod pa ni/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus gzugs la sogs pa'i yul lnga baṃ yig gi rnam par pad+ma'i snying por bsdus te/

de las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams las/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i/ dhū pe/ kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*// mar mes gang ba'i/ ā lo ke /gdung sel ljang khu/ dri chab byug pa'i/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas ser mo/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i/ nai wi d+ye/ sgra brnyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa/ de nas dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i zhal nas bstod pa byung bar mos te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs kyis bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs la bde legs thob// der ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro rnams dang*// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad cing*// sgyu ma'i sprul pas don kun sgrub mdzad pa// rdo rje btsun mo yan lag ma la 'dud// mdun du rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mgo bo gsum la gnas pa'i yi ge a rnam par 'gyur ba las thod pa'i nang du/ go ku na ha da las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ rang rang gi sa bon de dag gis mtshan pa'i khar oṃ de'i 'od zer gyis thams cad kyis ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dkar po mgo 'thur du blta bas kha bcad/ rlung gis me sbar rdzas rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun nyi ma 'char ka lta bu la/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ dang bcas pa'i zla ba la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug rnams spyan drangs snyoms par zhugs nas thim ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas babs pas mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho/

kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi ge hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lces myang bar bya'o// spro ba'i sbyor bas lha mo'i tshogs kyang tshim par bya'o// brgyad pa ting nge 'dzin ni / ā li kā li bdun bsams nas// zhes nas/ de las gzugs ni thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar te gzhan du shes par bya'o// de'i rjes la/ snying gar baṃ zla nyi'i steng du gnas pa sngags kyi 'phreng ba shin tu phra ba mngon par bltas la/ brtan pa'i sems su gyur nas lha'i 'khor lo spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du bzlas par bya ste/ de la sngags ni/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki? nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gtso mo'i snying po dang nye snying ngo*// oṃ ḍā ki? nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me= oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi= oṃ rū pi ni ye/ oṃ kā kā s+ye/ oṃ ū lū kā s+ye/ oṃ shwa nā kā s+ye/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ya/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi nī ye/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye/ lha mo rnams kyi sngags so// de nas bdud rtsi ji lta ba bzhin du gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang stang stabs bcas te/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gu ru shrī badz+ra yo gi nī/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ya ā kaḍ+ḍha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki? nī hṛ da ya/ a pa to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba wī ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi shul 'brang ba sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad gang bar byon/ lag pa pad kor byas te/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ lan gsum/ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis med du byas te/

oṃ ā ra li hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki? nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ ṣ+ya hoḥ lan gsum mam bzhi lngar brjod la 'das pa rnams la phul/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tson+mā dā pasmā ra/ badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi/ pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi/ bishud+dha ye sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchod pa lnga phul te/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod nas/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// pad+ma'i lag bskor byas te/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya che kun 'thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// ces 'dod pa'i dngos grub blangs te/

nye bar bsdu ba'i phyag rgya mi phyed par 'khyud pa sngon du 'gro bas mthe bong dang srin lag se gol brdab par bya ste/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra muḥ dgu pa ni/ dkyil 'khor ba la/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// nongs 'gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs// kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru// yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas su// slar yang 'byon par mdzod cig muḥ nus pa ma mchis ma tshang lhag /sngags dang bya ba cho ga nyams// gang byas gyur te gtso bo dang*// lha mo rnams kyis bzod par 'os// dbang phyug dam par bka' drin stsol// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad bdag nyid la gzhug par byas te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces bsngo ba byas te/ tshul khrims tsan dan sku la byug /bsam gtan gyi ni na bza' gsol// byang chub yan lag me tog bkram// ji ltar bde ba bzhin du spyod// ces pa'i rjes spyod la 'jug go /da ni tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ stegs bu gtsang ma'i khar ras bris sam tshom bu bkod pa'am rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' ma mchod pas legs par bskor/ bum pa nang rdzas steng du rnam rgyal chen po rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad dag gis mdun bdar nas/ bdud rtsi ril bus kha dag par byas nas rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma la baṃ dmar po/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong mdzub mo gung srin mthe'u chung rnams kyi dbus su rim pa ji lta bar/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yauṃ hriṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rtsa ba dang rtse mo rnams la phaṭ phaṭ/ bdag bskyed bzhin bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa blangs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ shar du'o/ /oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ byang du'o// oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nub tu'o// oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lho ru'o// phyogs su se gol brdabs pa yis// gdug pa'i bdud ni bskrad par bya// zhes sdom 'byung las gsungs pa bzhin bdag nyid la mngon par 'thor ba dang*/ yan lag la 'god par byed cing 'di ka bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor gyi bsrung ba'o// de nas dri zhim po'i chus dkyil 'khor bsangs gtor byas la/ de'i dus su g.yon pa'i srin lag bzhag ste/ pū dzā o a go ra de mākā o tri ko ka laṃ kā hi pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/

yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ pu li ra ma dang*/ dzā lan+dha ra dang*/ auḍ+ḍi yā ṇa dang*/ ar+pu ta bzhi gnas te sa rab tu dga' ba/ go dā wa ri dang*/ ra me shwa ri dang*/ de wi ko ṭa/ mā la wa bzhi nye ba'i gnas/ sa dri ma med pa/ kā ma ru dang*/ o tre gnyis zhing*/ sa 'od byed pa/ tī sha ku ne dang*/ ko sa la gnyis nye zhing*/ sa 'od 'phro ba/ ka liṅka dang*/ laṃ pa ka gnyis tshan+do/ sa sbyang dka' ba/ kāñtsi dang*/ hi ma lā gnyis nye ba'i tshan+do/ sa mngon du gyur pa/ pre ta pu ri dang*/ gṛ ha de wa gnyis 'du ba/ sa ring du song ba/ sau raṣ+ṭa dang*/ su war+ṇa dwī pa gnyis nye ba'i 'du ba/ sa mi g.yo ba/ na ga ra dang*/ sin+dhu gnyis dur khrod/ sa legs pa'i blo gros/ ma ru dang ku lu ta gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod/ sa chos kyi sprin zhes brjod cing yul de dag tu gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas par bsam par bya'o// sprul sku'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas/ oṃ shūn+ya tā/ zhes nas/ kha sbyor gyi dbus su snying ga'i sa bon las rnam par spros pa'i baṃ yig /de rnams ro gcig tu nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ de dag la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bcug pa nas rgyas btab kyi bar yang de bzhin la/ yid las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis me tog la sogs pas mchod par mos te/ rnam par sbyangs pa'i lag pa g.yon pas me tog oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bcom ldan 'das ma la phul zhing*/ yang snying po dang nye snying gi sngags dag nas gshin rje 'joms ma la thug gi bar rang rang gi sngags kyis phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis mchod par bya'o// de bzhin bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo 'bul ba phyi mchod/ mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi waṃ ma// rgyud mangs snyan pa'i skad kyis yid sgyur byed// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje'i yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje'i gling bu ma// snyan 'gyur rin chen gling bu sgra dbyangs can// waṃ se/ bim+ba ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma// skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol/ mu rañdze/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma// rnga chen cher sgrogs nam mkha'i phyogs kun 'gegs// mṛ taṃ ge pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa mo// 'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis kun dga' bskyed// hā s+ye/ mthon ka chen po'i 'od 'dzin rab sgeg mo// rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyems pa'i tshul// lā s+ye/ btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan// gī tī/ rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma// mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gi bro gar bsgyur// nṛ t+ye/ ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// puṣ+pe/ sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug pa ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can// dhū pe/ gur kum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed// dī paṃ/ 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar skya byug pa ma// legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pa sel// gan+dhe/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs brnyan ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob// rū pa/ le brgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin// rā sa/ dūr ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin// spar+she/ kun+da ku mud rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun skyed skye gnas phyag rgya can// dharma dhā tu/ nang mchod do/ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/

rtsa rgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki? nas/ ya ma ma thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa sogs sbyar/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen po bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du/ gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du/ gsang mchod do/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i dmigs pa dang*// phyag rgya chen po gcig sbyor bas// 'phel ba'i mi 'gyur bde bas mchod// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug khyod la bdud// dpal ldan rdo rje dang*/ ji snyed rdo rje/

zhes pas bstod/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la/ oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo mdun nas g.yon skor gyis/ haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ sreg byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha/ mthe bong la/ oṃ haḥrdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gung mo la swa ha hu rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he he ru ka nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ'od dpag med mthing ka /sen mo rnams kyi ngos la phaṭ haṃ rta mchog ljang kha ུ'am sngags 'dam nga'o// oṃ baṃ sogs rang sngags kyi mthar/ puṣ+pe dhū pe zhes nas shap+ta'i bar/ mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rig ma'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog/ ces rig ma dang*/ bza' btung*/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /sarba pañtsa.a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi sa mchod/ de nas sor mo'i lha rnams lag mthil du byon te yab yum rjes su chags pa mdzad pa lag pa'i rgyab tu me long dwangs pa'i gzugs bzhin du gsal bar snang*/ de nas yab yum de dag sa la sogs pa khams drug gi lha mo chang gi khu bas byugs te lag pa de dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi ngo bo yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur pa la oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya/ mahā kalpag+ni san+ni bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭ+rā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhuṃ dza bhā su rā ya/ pa ra shu pā shod+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byāgh+ra dzi nām+ba radha rā ya/ ma hā dhū mabra n+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/

puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de nas phul ba'i me tog de/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ hra hraḥpheṃ pheṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ne/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gāṃ sar+pam+wā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i mthar dkyil 'khor du dor/ yang blangs nas thal mo sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas mgo bor bzhag go /lha'i 'khor lo de yang bdag nyid la zhugs par gyur ces yi ge brgya pa'i sngags brjod do// de nas phyogs kyi bdag po rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyir/ phyi rol du song nas/ shar du in+t+ra sa pā ri wā ra na ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ in+d+ra sa pa ri wā re i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum la sogs pas phul/ saṃ trip+ta sarba de wa tā sā dha ka s+ye shan+tiṃ ku ru sarba kar+yan tu sid+dhirba ti ya thā su khaṃ su ṣe/ dam can rgya mtsho sogs kyis 'dod pa'i don gsal lo// me/ ag+ni/ lho/ ya mā/ lho nub tu/ rāk+ṣa sa/ nub/ tu bā ru ṇa/ nub byang du/ bā yu/ byang du/ ku be ra/ dbang ldan du/ ma hā bhū ta/ steng du/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya bra h+ma ar+ya de wa ta/ 'og tu/ bai tsi tri pri thi wī/ de wa ta/ gzhan 'dra/ rgyas pa la/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo// nang du zhugs nas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*/ sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlags// gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyis rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin//

zhes pa'i glu len zhing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de la lan gsum du bskor ro// de nas 'dug ste sdig bshags nas bzlas pa'i bar byas/ bdag nyid las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bye nas sngar gyi sar bzhugs par bsam la/ bum pa bsang gtor byas/ oṃ shūn+ya tā sa stong par dmigs/ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ las phyi rin po che'i bum pa nang yangs pa'i dbus dang rnam rgyal chen po pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das nas/ drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ las bum du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin brlab go cha/ ye shes spyan drangs gi bar byas/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin chu gsum nyer spyod lnga'i sngags kyis mchod/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo de/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur pa las/ rgyas btab kyi bar byas/ yid las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hi pra war sat+ka rā ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhal bsil phul/ hi yan 'dra/ ar+ghaṃ ma ma/ tat+t+waṃ gṛh+ṇa sid+dhi me pra/ mchod yon/ hi sa tu da ka zhabs bsil/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// puṣ+pe/ tsan dan gur kum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol// dhū pe/ mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed pa// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te/ dī paṃ/ sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga bur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs pa// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// nai wid+ye/

bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// brgyad gnyis lang tsho dpal 'bras nu 'bur ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// nya rgyas zla ba dag pa'i bzhin ras ma// tshim zhing gsal la bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// rdo rje rig ma'i lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// wī ne sogs 'gre/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul/ rgod dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs bro gar mkhan// zur mig 'phen mkhas 'dod pa'i mda' mkhan ma// 'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg ma// yid 'phrog dpa' mo rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ma// 'gying gzugs glog 'dra gar dgu'i rtse 'jo ma// rdo rje/ me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog 'dzin// rnam rgyal pad dkar gzhon nu zhal mdzes ma// dri zhim ma li gsar pa'i ro ldan ma// mtshar sdug 'od kyis phyogs cha rnams 'gengs ma// ga bur tsan dan shing ltar gdung sel ma// rdo rje/ gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings lha mo ni// mdzes sdug dpe byad bzang po'i dpal ldan ma// ma mchu bdud rtsi gtsang ba'i ro ldan ma// reg byas dbang po kun nas tshim byed ma// bsam yas lhan cig skyes dga'i 'byung gnas ma// rdo rje/ rig ma'i/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/

rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ gtso mo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rang rang gi snying po bdun bdun bzlas/ sngags 'phreng gzungs thag la 'khril/ de rnam rgyal chen po'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar zhugs/ de 'od du zhu nas bum pa la thim/ de dag bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam mo// gzhan la bskur ba dang rab tu gnas pa sogs kyang mtshams 'dir bya'o// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am ston mo gnyis gang byed kyang rung bdag bskyed bzhin gtor ma btang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i mdun du stag lpags la sogs pa'i g.yang gzhi'i steng du chang dang bza' ba rnams bshams te/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab la byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis bsang gtor byas la/ de nas / lag pa g.yon bkab la oṃ yig gis sbyang bar bya'o// lag pa g.yas pa bkab āḥyig gis rtogs par bya'o// snyim pa bkab ste hūm̐ yig gis sbar bar bya'o// mkha' lding gi phyag rgya dang hoḥyig gis bdud rtsir bya zhing*/ hūm̐/ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan ye shes kun ldan ka pā la// de bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// ā ra li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa la// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha hoḥhriḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtogs sbar ba na// dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa ha dza so so rang rig gis// kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdam// zhes byin gyis brlabs te/ chang gi thig les g.yon pa'i ming med kyi rtse mos sa la chos 'byung gru gsum byas la/ de'i dbus su thig le ltar zlum skor la/ hūm̐/ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khrol lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'ur ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// yab khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze'u 'brus gang*// dngos grub kyi zil mngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyil li li// lha khyed dang*/

'gyur ba ma gtogs 'dra/ nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i rdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyob kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi/ ma/ khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i sde// mgon ma hā kā la lcam dral la// 'khor dregs pa'i lha tshogs nyi/ mgon khyed dang*/ zhes spyan drangs nas/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams khyab pa tsam du song ba'i steng gi char bla ma/ 'og gi char yi dam bsgoms pa bzhin la gsang sngags kyi lha thams cad gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ 'og tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma zhing skyong pho mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsams la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu byas la/ hūm̐/ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med 'char ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du spar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tshos rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// tshogs phud gnyis pa la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs la ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi btags pas dkyil 'khor la phul/ gsum pa la/ hūm̐ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la// de yan sngar bzhin gyis phul/ bzhi pa/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med las gnyis su ston byed pa'i// sras rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍā ki? rgya mtsho la//

lnga pa la/ bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la// zhes pas phul/ yul de'i zhing skyong dang grong gi bdag po dang*/ oṃ yig dang*/ dbus su ming dang*/ mthar āḥhūm̐ che ge mo i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa sarba sa twa na maḥshīn+ti tsit+ta ku ru ku ru swāhā/ dbus su ming zhes pa/ de dag gi ming 'bru bzhi yod na mnyam pas yi ge dang po ming yin pas de 'jug /gsum na mi mnyam pa la gsum pa ming du 'gyur bas de 'jug pa yin no// des 'gre'o// oṃ hā ri ti piṇ+ḍa ke pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ 'phrog ma'i chang bu'i sngags/ oṃ du tī ke a gra gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bsngags nas bza' ba'i mtha' ji srid pa la gzhag go /de nas las kyi rdo rjes bza' ba sder du phul zhing btung ba pad+ma'i snod du 'bul te bskor ba gsum byas nas/ dri dang bdug pa dang me tog la sogs pa rnams kyi mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig ces pas so// de nas longs spyod/ brtag gnyis bzhin rdo rje'i glu dang gar bya/ lhag ma bsdus/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas myos byed kyi kha phru btab ste/ hūm̐/ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten pa// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki? ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// lus glog 'khyug me dpung 'u ru ru// ngag shugs glu zhud po di ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge nge*// las srid gsum myul la shar ra ra// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu 'bab// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen la rgyug

/mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag /pho mtshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo mchor mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par bsgom pa'i drod tshad myul// khyed dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas phul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣe bh+yaḥswāhā/ tshogs zhing gtor mgron/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas rang ngam rten la bstim/ gzhon nu ma'i tshogs mchod pa yang nus na bya'o// de nas nye bsdu bzhin du bdag bskyed bsdus/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na de nyid du bsgyur/ tshom bu yin na rang la bsdu/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang de'i dngos grub kyi phyir yin na gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// shis pa brjod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga slob dpon chen po mai tri pa'i bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs ji lta bar bshad cing tshogs kyi 'khor lor dgos pa phyag rdor stod 'grel dang bstun pa phun sum tshogs pa'i 'dod 'jor grags pa pad+ma dkar pos gzhan la sbyin pa'i chos su byar yul nas mo rdzong du yi ger btab pa'o// bdag nyid chen po'i lugs bzang thams cad du// ji ltar gnas pa mthong ba'i mig po che// tshul min mthong ba'i rab rib can rnams la// 'thing slad byed 'di bsod nams gar bu yin/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
